correctness.rationale: For every n>=4, b(S)=2r(S)+u(S) counts cycle-run boundaries and unmatched antipodal rungs. Parity and run analysis give minima beta(k): 3 at size 1 and 2n-1, 4 at even k, 5 at the other odd k. The paired order attains every beta(k), so sum minima is 9n-8. Even optimal intermediate prefixes are cyclic blocks of whole rung columns. For four initial and terminal vertices the permitted square permutations number 16 each; each of n-4 interior 2-vertex steps has 2 adjacent columns x 2 within-rung orders=4 choices. Therefore n*16*4^(n-4)*16=n*4^n distinct labeled optimal orders. Independently computed every 2^(2n) subset cut and exact DP optimum chain counts for n=4,5,6,7: 1024,5120,24576,114688, matching theorem; finite values corroborate, not prove general n.
